en: "Expansion parts" for those who have "PG 1/60 Strike Gundam" (sold separately 200411 general over-the-counter item).
To the ultimate perfect strike
PERFECT GRADE Multi Assault Striker Replacement Completed.
Introducing "expansion parts" that can be combined with your existing Perfect Grade Strike Gundam to reproduce the Perfect Strike Gundam.
*This product does not include the MS body.
*To reproduce Perfect Strike Gundam, this product and "PG 1/60 Strike Gundam" (sold separately 200411 general over-the-counter item) are required.
● PG Multiple Assault Striker is thoroughly reproduced with new modeling. Three-dimensional with precise details compliant with Perfect Grade.
- Reproduce the sword striker with new modeling. For the first time, the long anti-ship sword "Schwertgeber" has been made into a three-dimensional model with an impressive 1/60 scale.
- Reproduce the launcher striker with new modeling. The super high impulse cannon "Agni" uses a deployment gimmick at the muzzle.
- Reproduce the battery pack with new modeling. Equipped with a movable axis, it supports flexible movement up, down, left and right.
● Comes with a display stand that allows for dynamic posing.
● MarkingSeal including the Strike Gundam body is included.
*This product does not include the MS body.
Set contents: Ale Striker / Battery Pack / Sword Striker / Launcher Striker / MarkingSeal (Expansion parts + Strike Gundam body)
Accessories: Display stand
This product can be combined with "PG 1/60 Strike Gundam" (sold separately 200411 general over-the-counter sales item),
"Expansion parts" that can reproduce Perfect Strike Gundam.
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the published photo, this product and "PG 1/60 Strike Gundam" (sold separately 200411 general over-the-counter item) are required.
* Compatible with installation on assembled "PG 1/60 Strike Gundam" (sold separately).
It can also be installed with the LED unit (sold separately) incorporated into the main body MS (sold separately).
1/60 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS/PE/PVC
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo has been partially painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Please note that some of the clear parts may contain air bubbles due to the manufacturing process.
